method: All 31 existing profiles were checked against fresh official sources before new-provider discovery. Baidu and SiliconFlow live cards were inspected in the browser; other official sources were retrieved as public documents or direct HTML. This verifies published policies, not account bills. Of the existing profiles, 24 are fully reverified, five partially verified, AIHubMix unverified for a selected route, and Codex disabled with event completion unverified. Those seven verifiedAt values are unchanged. SiliconFlow is new relative to main, not newly launched today. Pending October 4/5 findings were independently rechecked against fetched origin/main ae8728a; those branches were not merged. All edits are in a temporary worktree, never the saved main checkout.

uncertainties: AIHubMix's aggregate, named routes and prices differ; the page explicitly describes automatic provider fallback. No universal weekday/holiday eligibility was established. Aggregate schedule remains unverified for a selected route; verifiedAt stays October 1.

DeepSeek's current table lists V4 Pro 0813 separately, but its September 10 announcement says Pro requests would route to Flash from September 14 04:00 UTC. Both official sources were read today. Current table schedule/rates are confirmed; conflicting routing/product scope prevents full re-verification; verifiedAt stays October 2.

Z.ai Flash publishes an October 7 end date and nightly 23:00–09:00 windows but not the final overnight cutoff. The existing window-start-date interpretation is retained and visibly qualified, not newly verified; verifiedAt stays October 2.

Baidu publishes September 24 00:00 through October 7 23:59, and the rates, but neither checked campaign source explicitly labels the time zone. The clock retains its existing Beijing-time assumption, with a visible warning and the prior October 2 verifiedAt values for both profiles.

Codex's original X announcement was readable today and describes a one-off reset tomorrow at 10:00 AM PST. It does not verify account reset completion. The announced October 3 event is past; the operator-requested disable and October 2 verifiedAt remain.

Tencent's October 31 retirement notice names deepseek-v4-flash-0731, not explicitly its vendor-direct variant. Current Vendor Direct schedule/prices are confirmed; full retirement coverage remains unverified and verifiedAt stays October 2.
SiliconFlow Hunyuan-A13B-Instruct lists 09:00–18:00 / other-hours prices but an explicit time zone and effective date were not established. It is not added.
B.AI GLM-5.2/5.3 offers remain on individual official model pages but not the central promotion index; platform settlement controls. Historical date-only start times are not newly certified.
Holiday exceptions are not inferred for SiliconFlow, Tencent, Ollama, Alibaba, above.dev or Swarms. DeepSeek/B.AI holiday dates in the clock currently cover 2026 only.
Ollama's live legacy model HTML says retired September 25; cached web retrieval returned August 27. The current direct response is preferred, and main's September 25 value is retained.
